personality_one_liner: A high-speed emergency command center pairing dark operational surfaces with warm amber metrics for instant situational clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm with tight metric padding for high-density situational awareness

do's: Use glass headers and sticky filters over scrolling data streams
Apply translucent tinted base over operational map backdrops
dont's: Never blur dense data tables or core telemetry readouts
Do not use heavy gradients on form inputs

screens.name: Live Hospital Dashboard
screens.purpose: Monitor real-time ICU and bed capacity across connected healthcare facilities with instant alert toggles.

states.loading: Displaying live telemetry skeleton with pulsing skeleton cards
states.empty: No active hospital data feeds found. Check network connection or retry sync.
states.error: Failed to sync real-time hospital metrics. Tap to reconnect secure FHIR stream.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with live connection badge, vertical summary cards with occupancy meters, list of hospitals with expandable ICU status and direct transfer triggers.

screens.name: Emergency Case Intake & AI Match
screens.purpose: Intake critical patient parameters, trigger deterministic matching with AI explanation, and recommend optimal hospital routing.

states.loading: AI neural engine evaluating live bed capacity, specialist availability, and transit ETA...
states.empty: Enter patient triage details to initialize intelligent hospital matching protocol.
states.error: AI matching service timeout. Falling back to deterministic geo-distance routing.

screens.layout: Step-by-step triage parameter selector (Vitals, Condition, Required Care), prominent 'Run AI Match' CTA, ranked hospital recommendation cards with match scores and breakdown.

screens.name: Ambulance & Specialist Tracking
screens.purpose: Track live coordinates of emergency transport vehicles and availability of on-call medical specialists.

states.loading: Acquiring GPS coordinates and telemetry data from active EMS units...
states.empty: No active emergency units dispatched in current sector.
states.error: GPS telemetry link interrupted. Showing last known sector cache.

screens.layout: Interactive operational sector map header, segmented tabs for Fleet and Specialists, filterable status cards with real-time ETA and direct communication links.

screens.name: Supply & Inventory Command
screens.purpose: Monitor and update critical medical reserves including blood types, oxygen cylinders, and emergency trauma kits.

states.loading: Synchronizing regional blood bank and oxygen supply ledgers...
states.error: Failed to retrieve inventory metrics. Tap to refresh encrypted ledger.

screens.layout: Category filter pills (Blood, Oxygen, Trauma, PPE), visual stock level bars with low-reserve warning badges, quick-edit inventory modal trigger.

screens.name: Secure Role & Settings Hub
screens.purpose: Manage role-based access tokens, FHIR data exchange sync status, and emergency coordinator credentials.

states.loading: Verifying JWT session credentials and permission scopes...

screens.layout: User profile banner with role badge, security settings toggle list, FHIR protocol status card, and secure logout action.

hero_radar.alt: Dark medical emergency command center radar background

hospital_map.alt: Modern hospital emergency ward and telemetry monitors

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Code Nova as a high-performance Dark-First Utility emergency healthcare coordination platform in React Native / Expo. Adhere strictly to Personality 7 with warm amber accents (#F59E0B) on deep obsidian surfaces (#0E1116). Ensure touch targets are ≥44pt, use Barlow Condensed for numeric and metric displays, and Satoshi for readable body text. Every screen must have fully functional Loading, Empty, and Error states. Provide seeded demo data for hospitals, ambulances, specialists, and supply inventory with editable local updates. Integrate deterministic hospital matching with AI explanation toggles. Respect safe areas and keep primary CTAs pinned above tab bars with glass backgrounds where applicable.
